info.title: Sail API
info.description: The register. Every client (POS, back office, guest app, print relay, agents over MCP) calls these operations. All amounts are integer cents. Every mutation needs an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Liveness and database connectivity. No authentication. Never returns business data.
Returns the caller's principal: type, role, merchant and outlet scope. Use it to decide which buttons to show; the server enforces permissions regardless.

post.description: Development and tests only. Disabled in production.

get.description: Tax mode, GST rate, cash rounding and business-day cutoff for the caller's merchant.
get.summary: Get the merchant and its settings

patch.description: Changes tax mode, GST rate, cash rounding increment or the business-day cutoff. Affects every outlet. Orders already priced keep their snapshot.

get.description: Brands of the caller's merchant.

post.description: Creates a brand under the merchant.

patch.description: Renames a brand or changes its accent colour; archive by setting archived.

get.description: Outlets the caller can see (their outlet scope).

post.description: Creates an outlet with its hours, UEN and business-day cutoff.

patch.description: Changes an outlet's details, hours, UEN or cutoff.

get.description: POS stations of an outlet with their settings and pairing state.

post.description: Creates a station record for an outlet. Pair an iPad to it with stations.pair.

patch.description: Changes a station's layout, printers, pay-before-firing or seat settings.

get.description: Staff of the merchant with role and outlet scope. PINs are never returned.

post.description: Adds a staff member with a role, outlet and brand scope, optional back-office email and POS PIN.

patch.description: Changes role, scope, PIN or active state.

get.description: Who did what, on which target, when, and who approved it. Filter by actor, action, target or time.
Events for an outlet after a sequence number. This is the source of truth for every live view; the SSE stream only signals that new events exist.
Server-sent events signalling new outlet events and print jobs. Clients catch up with events.list on connect, on a sequence gap, on visibility change and on `resync`.

get.description: Every rule with its versions, or only the set active at a given time (`active_at`). Fees and discounts share one shape.

post.description: Creates a new rule, or a new version of an existing rule key, effective from a given time. Earlier orders keep their snapshot. Admin only.
Stops every version of a rule from applying to new orders. Admin only.

Prices a sample basket for an outlet, order type, channel and customer groups with the active rules (or a supplied rule set) and returns the full step-by-step trace. Pure: writes nothing. Totals come from the register, never from the caller.
Warnings for likely mistakes: overlapping exclusive rules, products no fee covers, caps below the minimum. Optionally validates a proposed rule set instead of the active one.

Queues a dry run by default: the worker produces a report of creates, updates, unchanged and rejected rows (with reasons) without changing data. Apply it with imports.apply. Records match on legacy_id or SKU, so re-runs update instead of duplicating.
post.summary: Upload legacy CSV files and queue an import

get.description: Import jobs with status and report summary.
The full dry-run or apply report, including rejected rows and reasons.
get.summary: Get an import job with its full report

post.description: Queues the same files and mapping for real. The approver must be a human Admin.

get.description: The catalogue in the importer's own column format, so an export can be edited and re-imported.

post.description: Admin only. The 6-digit code is shown once and expires in 10 minutes. The iPad enters it in stations.pair.
post.summary: Issue a one-time pairing code for a station

post.description: Exchanges a one-time pairing code for a long-lived station token. No authentication; the code is single-use. Pairing again replaces the previous token.
post.summary: Pair an iPad to a station

post.description: Station token plus 6-digit PIN → a short-lived PIN session token for the staff member. Lockout after repeated failures. The session ends after inactivity.
post.summary: Sign in on a station with a PIN

post.description: Ends the current PIN session.

A Manager+ enters their PIN to authorise a single action (for example a void after firing or a refund) for the signed-in staff member, without switching users. Returns a single-use grant bound to that action and target, valid for 2 minutes. Pass it as `override_id` on the protected request.
post.summary: Manager override: approve one restricted action

post.description: Opens an order of one type (dine-in with a table and pax; takeaway with an optional name; pickup with a customer reference and ready-by; delivery with address). Returns the priced snapshot. At most one open dine-in order per table.

get.description: The priced order: lines, adjustments, totals, checks, payments and balance. Amounts come from the register; never recompute them.

patch.description: Pax, customer reference, ready-by, delivery address, notes. Fields must be valid for the order type.

get.description: Orders of an outlet by status, type, table, business date or search; takeaway/pickup/delivery sorted by ready-by.

post.description: Re-runs the pricing pipeline on the order's current lines (optionally with hypothetical extra lines) and returns totals with every step. Pure: writes nothing.
post.summary: Quote an order with the full pricing trace

post.description: Re-prices with the new type's prices and fees. Blocked after the first payment.
Customer-group conditions re-evaluate; frozen order-level results stay frozen.

delete.description: Removes the customer; group discounts re-evaluate.

post.description: The target table must have no open order.
post.summary: Move an order to another table

post.description: All-or-nothing: every line must be on the channel's menu, available, not sold out, within its daily cap, and have valid modifiers (min/max, nesting to 2 levels). Open prices need Manager+ (or an override). Returns the re-priced snapshot.

patch.description: Quantity, notes, seat, hold/unhold or modifiers on a line that has not been sent to the kitchen. Caps are re-checked on a quantity increase.

post.description: A reason is required. Before sending: Server+ and the daily cap is released. After sending: Manager+ or a manager override, and a void ticket prints to the printers that got the item. Not on a line whose bill has a payment.
Fires the given lines (default: every pending, unheld line). Creates one print job per target printer in the same transaction. On a pay-before-firing station, blocked until the balance is 0.
From fired to ready (pickup and delivery lists).
Delivery orders only, from ready.
post.summary: Mark a delivery order out for delivery

post.description: Only with no payments and no fired lines (void fired lines first, which needs Manager+). Releases daily caps.

Applies a manual discount or waiver (for example staff meal, % off item, service-charge waiver) with its entered value and lines. The rule's own minimum role, override and reason settings apply. Automatic rules never need applying.

delete.description: Blocked when the adjustment is frozen by a payment.
delete.summary: Remove a manual pricing rule from an order

get.description: Areas and tables with live status (free, seated, sent, bill requested, paid), pax, elapsed time, pending QR rounds and table requests.

post.description: Admin only; expires in 15 minutes. The relay device exchanges it for a relay token with relays.pair.
post.summary: Issue a one-time pairing code for a print relay

post.description: Exchanges a pairing code for a relay token. No authentication; single-use code. Pairing a spare replaces the previous token.
Every 30 s: version and printer reachability. Relay principal only.

get.description: Relay principal only.
Queued (and the relay's own claimed) jobs with their ESC/POS payloads. The relay calls this on connect and after every reconnect (catch-up).
get.summary: Outstanding print jobs for a relay

get.description: Signals new or changed print jobs for the relay's outlet. Catch up with relays.jobs on connect and on `resync`.

post.description: Relay principal only. Moves queued → claimed; another relay claiming the same job gets state_conflict.
Relay principal only. claimed → printed, or → failed with the error. Retries reuse the job ID.

get.description: By status, printer or order; `late=true` returns jobs not printed within 10 seconds (the POS alert). Includes the plain-text rendering for previews.

post.description: A new job marked REPRINT on the same printer.
New jobs on the target printer (default: each printer's configured backup); the originals are marked rerouted. Not for jobs already printed.
post.summary: Reroute waiting tickets to another printer

post.description: Sends a test ticket to a printer. Admin.

get.description: Checks with allocations, payments and balances.

post.description: Applies a tender to the bill's balance. Non-cash amounts cannot exceed the balance. Cash rounding applies only to a cash tender that settles the balance and is returned as rounding_cents; the register computes change due. The first payment freezes order-level pricing and locks the bill's allocations. When every bill is paid and every item is sent, the order completes. Idempotent by payment_id.
post.summary: Record a payment on a bill

post.description: Every bill paid (balance 0) and every item sent or removed.
Same business day, Manager+ (or override). Reverses the order's payments as events and unlocks the bills; the order is then recharged.
Prints the bill (or every bill of the order) on the station's receipt printer and marks the table as bill requested.
Prints the receipt for a paid bill on the station's receipt printer.
Creates a receipt link (for a QR code on screen) or queues an email/SMS. Email and SMS need a provider, which is not configured yet; the link always works.

get.description: Public, by token: the receipt document for the guest's phone.

post.description: Numbered PDF tax invoice for a paid bill, including the outlet UEN. Gap-free numbering per merchant. Issued once; later calls return the same number.

get.description: The PDF for an issued invoice.
Open and closed shifts with their summaries.

post.description: With a counted float. One open shift per station (or per outlet when no station).
With the counted cash. Returns expected vs counted cash including rounding, and the shift's Z figures. Cashier+ for own shift; Manager+ for another's.

get.description: Sales, tenders, expected vs counted cash, rounding, voids and covers for an outlet (or station) and business date. Figures come from the register.

post.description: Snapshots the Z-report once every shift is closed. Manager+.
N bills, every item shared 1/N. Bills add up to the order to the cent (largest remainder; bill order breaks ties). Only before the first payment.
One bill per seat number; items without a seat are shared evenly across the seats, or put on a separate Shared bill with `shared: manual`.
Put each listed item wholly on one bill, or share it equally between the listed bills (a bottle three ways). A paid bill's allocations are locked.
post.summary: Move or share items between bills

post.description: Only before the first payment.
Reversal per line, adjustment and GST, plus the split across the original payments with per-payment caps and cash rounding. Pure: writes nothing. Agents must show these figures, never their own.

Full, by lines and quantities, or by amount. Manager, Finance or Admin, or a lower role with a manager override. Reason required. Produces a numbered refund receipt and, when the bill was invoiced, a numbered credit note. Each line's refunds never exceed its paid amount; each payment's refunds never exceed what it paid. Refunded items do not restore daily caps.

get.description: Refunds with their lines, tenders and document numbers.
The credit note for a refund against an invoiced bill.

post.description: Reprints the refund receipt on the station's receipt printer.
A public link (QR) for the refund receipt.

Exchanges the table token for a short-lived guest token scoped to the table and its open order. Rate-limited per device and per table. Ordering is possible only while the table has an open order, unless the channel allows opening on first scan.
post.summary: Start a guest session from a table QR code

get.description: The table's lines (menu prices only, no fees or totals), round statuses and the guest's requests.

post.description: Lines in the same shape as lines.add, validated against the channel menu, availability and caps. With hold orders on, the round waits for staff acceptance; otherwise it fires and prints straight away. Never takes payment.
post.summary: Send a round to the table's order

post.description: One of the channel's configured requests or `call_for_bill`, which also marks the table as bill requested. Rate-limited.

get.description: Signals changes to the table's order (round accepted, order ready). Poll guest.order when there is no order yet.

200.description: text/event-stream: hello, change, resync for the table's order

get.description: Pending rounds waiting for acceptance, and recent decided ones.

post.description: Fires the round's lines and prints kitchen tickets.
Removes the round's lines with the given reason and releases daily caps.

get.description: Open and recently acknowledged requests.

post.description: Marks the request done.
Old QR codes for the table stop working. Admin.

get.description: Rotates every table token at the outlet and returns a PDF of QR cards for ordinary printers. Admin.

Totals and breakdowns (by day, order type, source, tender, category, rule and reporting class, voids, refunds) for a date range with filters for outlet, brand, station, shift, source, order type, staff and category. `format=csv` returns CSV. Every figure is a sum of register-written cents.
Quantity, gross, discounts and net by item, category or staff member, with share of net in basis points.
Who voided, discounted or refunded, who approved, the reason and the rule applied.
Jobs, printed, failed, rerouted, reprinted and late counts with p50/p95 fire-to-printed seconds by printer and relay.
The Z-report plus breakdowns for one outlet and business date; `.pdf` for the printable summary.
The merchant's agent identities with role, scope, toolsets, ceiling and status. Credentials are never returned.

post.description: Admin. Name, role, outlet and brand scope, toolsets and risk ceiling (T0 to T2; no agent reaches T3). Returns the credential once; store it in the agent runner's secrets.

patch.description: Admin. Widening scope, role, toolsets or ceiling is a T3 change; disabling an identity revokes its live sessions at once (kill switch).

post.description: Admin. The old credential stops working and live sessions are revoked. Returns the new credential once.

Exchanges an agent credential for a 15-minute agent token bound to a task. With `on_behalf_of` (a staff PIN session or back-office token) the effective role is the lower of the agent's and the person's, and the outlet scope is the intersection, so an agent never does for a Server what the Server could not.

get.description: Pending proposals waiting for a human, and recent decided ones. Agents see their own.
Status, frozen request, decision and the executed result. Agents poll this after a `requires_confirmation` response.

post.description: A human with the operation's role approves; the register executes the frozen request exactly, as the approver, with the frozen idempotency key. The approver cannot be the proposer. If the target changed, execution fails with version_conflict and the proposal is marked failed.
With a reason, shown to the agent. Rejections become eval cases.
